milestone: M1 general Windows game foundations; original Act 1 content used for validation

status_definitions.pass: Required behavior has been exercised with evidence at the stated verification scope.
status_definitions.fail: An attempted acceptance check demonstrated missing or incorrect required behavior.
status_definitions.not_run: No adequate acceptance execution evidence has been reviewed; source or unit checks alone do not establish integrated acceptance.

scope_constraints: Scene/module loading, rendering, cameras and character animation accept supplied content rather than map-specific implementations.
Original Act 1 assets are validation inputs; the foundation architecture is for the whole game.
Camera timeline is a general presentation mechanism, not acceptance of complete original cinematics.
Character defaults are foundation fixtures rather than recovered original gameplay balance.
Combat, quests, NPC behavior, bosses and whole-game campaign progression remain later work.
World/campaign persistence is later scope; this checkpoint verifies character data across process restart.

requirements.requirement: Windows EXE opens a window, accepts input and discovers or accepts an asset folder
requirements.remaining: Mechanism accepted: native open, process-owned key messages/focus reset, asset discovery and clean exit. Physical keyboard/mouse interaction manually untested.

requirements.requirement: General scene/module inputs render original geometry/materials with a controllable development camera
requirements.remaining: Mechanism accepted: generic level/module loading, textured scene GPU output, camera units and native timeline poses. Complete original material/light/effect fidelity and physical free-camera interaction remain pending.

requirements.requirement: Data-driven character model/clip loading displays original validation character and development controls select idle/walk/attack
requirements.remaining: Mechanism accepted: data-driven model and named clips, three pose updates in native character probe, textured actor visible in scene. Manual 1/2/3 switching and broad NPC/boss/cinematic actor coverage remain untested.

requirements.requirement: General short camera timeline moves, rotates and cuts within a supplied scene
requirements.remaining: General mechanism accepted; complete original cinematic reconstruction remains later scope.

requirements.requirement: Identity/class/stats/XP/inventory/equipment/skills/unlocks survive save, application close and reopen
requirements.remaining: All field families roundtrip in tests; separate packaged process restores modified name. Campaign save compatibility/persistence remains later scope.

requirements.requirement: Packaged build integrates 1A-1E, resizes, loads/unloads scene and exits cleanly outside development workspace
requirements.remaining: Mechanism accepted: final portable package smoke, actor-in-scene capture, unload/reload at frame15, window resize/reopen probe, save process restart, clean shutdown. Physical interactive complete playthrough remains untested.

notes: Initial audit records code presence only. No integrated runtime acceptance has yet been reviewed.
User corrected scope to whole-game general foundations. Asset-specific presets are acceptable at the content boundary; hardcoded model/clip/map behavior inside general adapters is not.
Latest reviewed CTest execution: 5/5 passed (save, camera, asset, level_manifest, original_character). Main timeline toggle now restores free camera on T.

Native and portable-package receipts status pass reviewed. Before/after5-second camera-cut images independently inspected; world remains visible at different poses. Full interactive input coverage is not established by automated receipts.

Final packaged executable hash verified in final receipt; six CTest suites pass, including process-owned window keydown/up/focus clearing and resize/reopen. Final integrated reload log records content unload/reload at frame15 and clean shutdown after30 frames.

architecture_review.scene_inputs: Generic BDAE scene and authored module selector/placement accepted
architecture_review.character_inputs: Model/template paths, arbitrary named clip bank and loop/one-shot selection supplied through configuration; preview enum retained as convenience
open_items: Full original rendering material/effect/lighting coverage remains incomplete; generalized architecture does not imply all original effect domains supported.

visual_verification.observation: 1280x720 native capture visibly contains textured connected module terrain/architecture. Broad framing and dark appearance leave material fidelity, transparency and camera interaction pending.
1280x720 native capture visibly contains coherent textured Prince model. A single still does not establish animation transitions or full clip playback.

visual_verification.check: Integrated textured actor in original validation scene
visual_verification.observation: Independently inspected native capture shows coherent textured Prince placed within textured authored world after unload/reload. Collision, gameplay, quests and original lighting are not established.

checkpoint.scope: General native foundation mechanisms verified through automated probes and inspected GPU captures

acceptance_scope: Automated general-foundation mechanism checkpoint. Full original renderer coverage and complete interactive/gameplay milestone are not accepted by this report.
outstanding_coverage: Physical keyboard/mouse control and manual complete interaction checks were not run.
Renderer supports the checkpoint material subset; full original effects, dynamic lighting, skybox and all transparency cases require later coverage.
Validation world instantiates geometry, not module gameplay objects, quests, campaign predicates or NPC/boss behavior.
Original complete cinematics, dialogue/audio playback and camera track reconstruction are not implemented or accepted here.
Exact original NewGame opening selection remains historically unverified in bounded asset audit.
